sourceTitle: Old-Fashioned Ethics and Common-Sense Metaphysics With Some of Their Applications
description: "Old-Fashioned Ethics and Common-Sense Metaphysics" by William Thomas Thornton is a philosophical treatise written in the late 19th century. The work delves into ethical principles and metaphysical inquiries, focusing particularly on common-sense approaches to understanding morality, duty, and the human condition.
